{
  "summary": "Removes default construction and the public `Init()` method from `PrecomputedTransactionData`, requiring transaction context and optional spent outputs at construction time. Validation and test call sites that defer precomputation now use `std::optional<PrecomputedTransactionData>`, emplacing the object only after a script-cache miss. The PR also skips txdata allocation during block connection when assumevalid bypasses script checks, and eliminates an unintended copy of caller-supplied txdata in the kernel C API.",
  "problem": "Default-constructing `PrecomputedTransactionData` and initializing it later through `Init()` allowed instances to exist uninitialized or be reused across transactions. The old `Init()` safety guard checked only `m_spent_outputs_ready`, which stayed false after forced initialization without spent outputs even though BIP143 sighash hashes were cached. Additionally, the experimental kernel C verification API copied caller txdata on every call due to ternary expression typing, and `ConnectBlock()` allocated unused txdata memory during assumevalid verification.",
  "evidence": [
    "PR description: \"The old Init() guard only checked m_spent_outputs_ready, which remained false after forced initialization without spent outputs even though force=true cached the BIP143 prevout, sequence, and output hashes for witness-v0 sighash.\"",
    "Commit d07c727ff8: \"Reproducer: https://godbolt.org/z/PzcKGW9da (GCC 15.2: one copy before, none after).\"",
    "PR description references closed PR #35663 (\"validation: avoid preallocating unused txdata during assumevalid\"), whose memory optimization is incorporated directly into ConnectBlock()."
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "depends_on": [],
    "enables": []
  },
  "scope_notes": "Touches 17 files, but most edits are mechanical adaptations across call sites (PSBT, wallet feebumper, fuzz targets, test fixtures) replacing two-step `PrecomputedTransactionData` initialization with direct construction or `std::optional` wrapping.",
  "changed_since_previous": "",
  "card": "Removes default construction and the public Init() method from PrecomputedTransactionData, ensuring instances are immutably bound to a specific transaction and spent outputs upon construction. Validation and tests now hold an std::optional to defer construction until a script-cache miss, while ConnectBlock skips allocating txdata vectors entirely when assumevalid bypasses script verification. It also fixes an unintended copy of caller-supplied txdata on every call in the experimental bitcoinkernel C API, corroborated by a compiler reproducer.",
  "needs": [],

    "level": "medium",
    "touches": [

result.summary: Removes default construction and the public `Init()` method from `PrecomputedTransactionData`, requiring transaction context and optional spent outputs at construction time. Validation and test call sites that defer precomputation now use `std::optional<PrecomputedTransactionData>`, emplacing the object only after a script-cache miss. The PR also skips txdata allocation during block connection when assumevalid bypasses script checks, and eliminates an unintended copy of caller-supplied txdata in the kernel C API.
result.problem: Default-constructing `PrecomputedTransactionData` and initializing it later through `Init()` allowed instances to exist uninitialized or be reused across transactions. The old `Init()` safety guard checked only `m_spent_outputs_ready`, which stayed false after forced initialization without spent outputs even though BIP143 sighash hashes were cached. Additionally, the experimental kernel C verification API copied caller txdata on every call due to ternary expression typing, and `ConnectBlock()` allocated unused txdata memory during assumevalid verification.
evidence: PR description: "The old Init() guard only checked m_spent_outputs_ready, which remained false after forced initialization without spent outputs even though force=true cached the BIP143 prevout, sequence, and output hashes for witness-v0 sighash."
Commit d07c727ff8: "Reproducer: https://godbolt.org/z/PzcKGW9da (GCC 15.2: one copy before, none after)."
PR description references closed PR #35663 ("validation: avoid preallocating unused txdata during assumevalid"), whose memory optimization is incorporated directly into ConnectBlock().
result.scope_notes: Touches 17 files, but most edits are mechanical adaptations across call sites (PSBT, wallet feebumper, fuzz targets, test fixtures) replacing two-step `PrecomputedTransactionData` initialization with direct construction or `std::optional` wrapping.
result.card: Removes default construction and the public Init() method from PrecomputedTransactionData, ensuring instances are immutably bound to a specific transaction and spent outputs upon construction. Validation and tests now hold an std::optional to defer construction until a script-cache miss, while ConnectBlock skips allocating txdata vectors entirely when assumevalid bypasses script verification. It also fixes an unintended copy of caller-supplied txdata on every call in the experimental bitcoinkernel C API, corroborated by a compiler reproducer.

risk.why: A mistake in initializing or binding PrecomputedTransactionData could corrupt sighash computations during script execution, causing invalid transactions to be accepted or valid blocks to be rejected.
